"""Exports the data the specimen app (specimen/, SvelteKit) is built from.

Writes specimen/src/lib/data/specimen.json (metrics, weights, versions and every glyph cell's
outline), copies the variable fonts (Llama Sans, one font over wght and opsz, and Llama Mono for its code sample) to specimen/src/lib/fonts/ and writes their @font-face rules
(fonts.css). Then build the page with:

    cd specimen && npm run build        # -> specimen/build/index.html, a single self-contained file

Run:  python scripts/build_specimen.py
      python scripts/build_specimen.py --prev-fonts=DIR [--fonts=DIR] [--prev-label="Before|After"]
      (--prev-fonts adds a floating Before/After switch comparing every version and the glyph grid with
       another build laid out like this folder: variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf and static/;
       --fonts takes the "after" build from somewhere other than this folder)
"""
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen
from fontTools.pens.boundsPen import BoundsPen
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont

APP = "specimen"
VARIANTS = ["Display", "UI"]                  # the optical sizes the page can switch between (the axis's named ends)
GRID_VARIANT = "UI"                           # the glyph grid is drawn from the statics, which are cut at UI's size
STYLES = [(400, "Regular"), (500, "Medium"), (600, "SemiBold"), (700, "Bold")]
WATERFALL = [(400, "Regular"), (500, "Medium"), (600, "SemiBold"), (700, "Bold")]
GROUPS = [("Uppercase", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"),
          ("Lowercase", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"),
          ("Figures", "0123456789"),
          ("Punctuation & symbols", ".,:;!?'\"-–—()[]/&@#%*+=$€"),
          ("Llama icon · U+E000, U+E001, U+E002", "\ue000\ue001\ue002")]

PREV = next((os.path.abspath(a[13:]) for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith("--prev-fonts=")), None)
FONTS = next((os.path.abspath(a[8:]) for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith("--fonts=")), None)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))  # fonts/, one level above scripts/
PREV_LABELS = next((a[13:] for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith("--prev-label=")), "Before|After").split("|")


def bounds(font, ch):
    gs = font.getGlyphSet()
    pen = BoundsPen(gs)
    gs[font.getBestCmap()[ord(ch)]].draw(pen)
    return pen.bounds


def path(font, ch, dx, top):
    """SVG path of a glyph, flipped and placed (dx, top) in its cell, rounded to whole units."""
    name = font.getBestCmap().get(ord(ch))
    if not name:
        return None, 0
    gs = font.getGlyphSet()
    pen = SVGPathPen(gs, ntos=lambda v: f"{v:.0f}")
    gs[name].draw(TransformPen(pen, (1, 0, 0, -1, round(dx), top)))
    return pen.getCommands(), font["hmtx"][name][0]


def differs(a, b, tol=2):
    """True when two outlines differ by more than interpolation rounding (tol font units)."""
    na, nb = re.findall(r"-?\d+", a), re.findall(r"-?\d+", b)
    return len(na) != len(nb) or any(abs(int(x) - int(y)) > tol for x, y in zip(na, nb))


SMALL_SIZES = [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16]         # the font sizes (CSS px) the small-sizes section sets


def small_tracking(path):
    """Units each advance gains at SMALL_SIZES over the font's opsz 16, read off the n (a size below the axis clamps)."""
    font = TTFont(path)
    lo = next(a.minValue for a in font["fvar"].axes if a.axisTag == "opsz")
    width = lambda size: font.getGlyphSet(location={"opsz": max(size, lo)})["n"].width
    return [round(width(size) - width(16)) for size in SMALL_SIZES]


def main():
    fonts = FONTS or "."
    statics = {w: TTFont(f"{fonts}/static/LlamaSans-{s}.ttf") for w, s in STYLES}
    base = statics[400]
    os2 = base["OS/2"]
    asc, dsc = round(bounds(base, "l")[3]), round(bounds(base, "p")[1])
    top, bot = asc + 60, dsc - 40
    chars = [c for _, s in GROUPS for c in s]
    vw = max(f["hmtx"][f.getBestCmap()[ord(c)]][0] for f in statics.values() for c in chars) + 60
    prev = {w: TTFont(f"{PREV}/static/LlamaSans-{s}.ttf") for w, s in STYLES} if PREV else {}

    cells = {}
    for w, font in statics.items():
        row = []
        for c in chars:
            _, adv = path(font, c, 0, top)
            dx = (vw - adv) / 2
            d, _ = path(font, c, dx, top)
            cell = {"ch": c, "adv": adv, "dx": round(dx), "d": d}
            if w in prev:
                pname = prev[w].getBestCmap().get(ord(c))
                if pname:
                    pd, _ = path(prev[w], c, (vw - prev[w]["hmtx"][pname][0]) / 2, top)
                    if differs(pd, d):
                        cell["prev"] = pd
            row.append(cell)
        cells[w] = row

    stems = {}
    for w, font in statics.items():
        b = bounds(font, "I")
        stems[w] = round(b[2] - b[0])
    axis = next(a for a in TTFont(f"{fonts}/variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf")["fvar"].axes if a.axisTag == "wght")

    fonts_dir = os.path.join(APP, "src", "lib", "fonts")
    os.makedirs(fonts_dir, exist_ok=True)
    for old in os.listdir(fonts_dir):  # start clean: a previous comparison build may be lying around
        if old.endswith(".ttf"):
            os.remove(os.path.join(fonts_dir, old))
    faces = []
    # brackets in file names trip up bundlers, so the app gets plain names
    shutil.copy(f"{fonts}/variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf", os.path.join(fonts_dir, "LlamaSans-VF.ttf"))
    faces.append(("Llama Sans", "LlamaSans-VF.ttf"))
    if PREV:
        shutil.copy(f"{PREV}/variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf", os.path.join(fonts_dir, "LlamaSansPrev-VF.ttf"))
        faces.append(("Llama Sans Prev", "LlamaSansPrev-VF.ttf"))
    if os.path.exists(f"{fonts}/variable/LlamaMono[wght].ttf"):  # Llama Mono, for the code sample
        shutil.copy(f"{fonts}/variable/LlamaMono[wght].ttf", os.path.join(fonts_dir, "LlamaMono-VF.ttf"))
        faces.append(("Llama Mono", "LlamaMono-VF.ttf"))
    with open(os.path.join(fonts_dir, "fonts.css"), "w") as f:
        f.write("/* generated by build_specimen.py */\n")
        for family, file in faces:
            f.write(f'@font-face {{ font-family: "{family}"; font-weight: {int(axis.minValue)} {int(axis.maxValue)}; '
                    f'src: url("./{file}") format("truetype-variations"); font-display: block; }}\n')

    data = {
        "glyphCount": len([g for g in base.getGlyphOrder() if g != ".notdef"]),
        "metrics": {"upm": base["head"].unitsPerEm, "cap": os2.sCapHeight, "x": os2.sxHeight, "asc": asc, "dsc": dsc},
        "axis": {"min": int(axis.minValue), "max": int(axis.maxValue)},
        "styles": [{"weight": w, "name": s, "stem": stems[w]} for w, s in STYLES],
        "waterfall": [{"weight": w, "name": s} for w, s in WATERFALL],
        "variants": VARIANTS,
        "compare": {"labels": PREV_LABELS} if PREV else None,
        "small": {"sizes": SMALL_SIZES, "tracking": small_tracking(f"{fonts}/variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf"),
                  "prevTracking": small_tracking(f"{PREV}/variable/LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf") if PREV else None},
        "grid": {
            "variant": GRID_VARIANT, "width": vw, "height": top - bot,
            "guides": {"base": top, "x": top - os2.sxHeight, "cap": top - os2.sCapHeight,
                       "asc": top - asc, "dsc": top - dsc},
            "groups": [{"title": t, "chars": list(s)} for t, s in GROUPS],
            "cells": cells,
        },
    }
    out = os.path.join(APP, "src", "lib", "data", "specimen.json")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print("wrote", out, os.path.getsize(out) // 1024, "KB, and", len(faces), "fonts to", fonts_dir)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.chdir(ROOT)  # every path is relative to fonts/, wherever this is run from
    main()

"""Builds the README's artwork in readme/: a specimen card for Llama Sans and one for Llama Mono, a palette card, and a
swatch per colour for the README's colour table, each card in a light and a dark version.

Text is shaped with HarfBuzz from the fonts in fonts/variable/ and outlined, as the logo's lockups are, so GitHub
shows the real typefaces without loading a font. Every colour, the skies' gradients included, is read from
css/colors.css and converted to sRGB hex. Run it again after a change to the fonts or the colours; the hex values in
the README's colour table are written by hand, so update those too.

Run:  uvx --with fonttools==4.68.0 --with uharfbuzz --with skia-pathops python readme/build_readme_art.py
"""
import io
import math
import os
import re
from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import OverlapMode, instantiateVariableFont
import uharfbuzz as hb

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
FONTS = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "fonts", "variable")
SANS, MONO = "LlamaSans[opsz,wght].ttf", "LlamaMono[wght].ttf"



def oklch_hex(l, c, h):
    """An OKLCH colour as sRGB hex, clipped to the gamut."""
    a, b = c * math.cos(math.radians(h)), c * math.sin(math.radians(h))
    lms = [(l + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b) ** 3, (l - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b) ** 3,
           (l - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.2914855480 * b) ** 3]
    rgb = [4.0767416621 * lms[0] - 3.3077115913 * lms[1] + 0.2309699292 * lms[2],
           -1.2684380046 * lms[0] + 2.6097574011 * lms[1] - 0.3413193965 * lms[2],
           -0.0041960863 * lms[0] - 0.7034186147 * lms[1] + 1.7076147010 * lms[2]]
    gamma = [12.92 * v if v <= 0.0031308 else 1.055 * v ** (1 / 2.4) - 0.055 for v in rgb]
    return "#" + "".join(f"{round(max(0, min(1, v)) * 255):02X}" for v in gamma)


def read_tokens():
    """css/colors.css's custom properties, each as its declared value."""
    css = open(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "css", "colors.css")).read()
    css = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", css, flags=re.S)
    return {name: " ".join(value.split()) for name, value in re.findall(r"--([\w-]+):\s*([^;]+);", css)}


TOKENS = read_tokens()


def colour(token):
    """A flat colour token as sRGB hex."""
    value = TOKENS[token]
    if value.startswith("#"):
        return value.upper()
    l, c, h = map(float, re.fullmatch(r"oklch\(([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+)\)", value).groups())
    return oklch_hex(l, c, h)


def sky(token):
    """A sky gradient's parts, as css/colors.css draws it: the colour and opacity of its first radial glow, and the
    stops of its linear gradient as (offset, hex)."""
    value = TOKENS[token]
    glow = re.search(r"radial-gradient\([^,]*,\s*(#\w+|rgb\([^)]*\))", value).group(1)
    alpha = 1.0
    if glow.startswith("rgb"):
        r, g, b, *rest = re.findall(r"[\d.]+", glow)
        glow, alpha = f"#{int(r):02X}{int(g):02X}{int(b):02X}", float(rest[0]) if rest else 1.0
    linear = re.search(r"linear-gradient\(([^)]*)\)", value).group(1)
    stops = [(int(p) / 100, c.upper()) for c, p in re.findall(r"(#\w+) (\d+)%", linear)]
    return glow.upper(), alpha, stops


INK, LIGHT, CINDER = colour("brand-ink"), colour("brand-light"), colour("art-cinder")


def rgba(hex_, alpha):
    return f"rgb({int(hex_[1:3], 16)} {int(hex_[3:5], 16)} {int(hex_[5:7], 16)} / {alpha})"


# the cards' grounds and inks: muted text at 62% of the ink, hairlines at 10% (13% on dark), as on communications'
# light and dark grounds
GROUNDS = {
    "light": dict(bg=LIGHT, ink=INK, muted=rgba(INK, 0.62), line=rgba(INK, 0.1)),
    "dark": dict(bg=INK, ink=LIGHT, muted=rgba(LIGHT, 0.62), line=rgba(LIGHT, 0.13)),
}

# the palette, by name and token
COLOURS = [(name, token, colour(token)) for name, token in (
    ("Ink", "brand-ink"),
    ("Light", "brand-light"),
    ("Sand 50", "sand-50"),
    ("Sand 100", "sand-100"),
    ("Sand ink", "sand-900"),
    ("Cinder", "art-cinder"),
    ("Cinder light", "art-cinder-light"),
    ("Day sky", "art-day-sky"),
    ("Night sky", "art-night-sky"),
)]

_fonts = {}


def font(path, **location):
    """The font at `path`, cut at `location` on its axes, with its bytes kept for HarfBuzz."""
    key = (path, tuple(sorted(location.items())))
    if key not in _fonts:
        cut = instantiateVariableFont(TTFont(os.path.join(FONTS, path)), location, inplace=False,
                                      overlap=OverlapMode.REMOVE)
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        cut.save(buf)
        cut = TTFont(io.BytesIO(buf.getvalue()))
        cut.hb = buf.getvalue()
        _fonts[key] = cut
    return _fonts[key]


def text(f, s, x, y, size, fill, tracking=0):
    """`s` set in font `f` at `size` px with its baseline at (x, y), as a <path>; returns (svg, width)."""
    face = hb.Face(hb.Blob(f.hb))
    buf = hb.Buffer()
    buf.add_str(s)
    buf.guess_segment_properties()
    hb.shape(hb.Font(face), buf, {"kern": True, "liga": True, "calt": True})
    k = size / f["head"].unitsPerEm
    gs, order = f.getGlyphSet(), f.getGlyphOrder()
    pen = SVGPathPen(gs, ntos=lambda v: f"{v:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip("."))
    pos = 0
    for info, p in zip(buf.glyph_infos, buf.glyph_positions):
        gs[order[info.codepoint]].draw(TransformPen(pen, (k, 0, 0, -k, x + (pos + p.x_offset) * k, y)))
        pos += p.x_advance + tracking * f["head"].unitsPerEm
    width = pos * k
    return f'<path fill="{fill}" d="{pen.getCommands()}"/>', width


def card(w, h, g, body):
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{w}" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}">'
            f'<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="{w - 1}" height="{h - 1}" rx="24" fill="{g["bg"]}" stroke="{g["line"]}"/>'
            f'{"".join(body)}</svg>\n')


def fits(width, limit, what):
    assert width <= limit, f"{what} is {width:.0f} px wide, over {limit}"


def sans_card(g):
    W, H, M = 1600, 900, 96
    label = font(MONO, wght=500)
    body = []
    t, _ = text(label, "LLAMA SANS", M, M + 20, 24, g["muted"], tracking=0.08)
    body.append(t)
    t, w = text(font(SANS, wght=700, opsz=36), "Simple by default,", M, 268, 112, g["ink"])
    fits(w, W - 2 * M, "headline")
    body.append(t)
    t, w = text(font(SANS, wght=700, opsz=36), "powerful on request.", M, 388, 112, g["ink"])
    fits(w, W - 2 * M, "headline")
    body.append(t)
    t, _ = text(font(SANS, wght=400, opsz=24), "One variable font, from 400 to 700, with an optical size from 10 to 36.",
                M, 470, 34, g["muted"])
    body.append(t)
    # the four weights, at the UI end
    x = M
    for name, wght in (("Regular", 400), ("Medium", 500), ("SemiBold", 600), ("Bold", 700)):
        t, w = text(font(SANS, wght=wght, opsz=16), name, x, 600, 52, g["ink"])
        body.append(t)
        x += w + 56
    fits(x - 56 - M, W - 2 * M, "weights")
    body.append(f'<rect x="{M}" y="650" width="{W - 2 * M}" height="1" fill="{g["line"]}"/>')
    for i, line in enumerate(("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789")):
        t, w = text(font(SANS, wght=400, opsz=16), line, M, 730 + i * 64, 44, g["ink"], tracking=0.01)
        fits(w, W - 2 * M, line)
        body.append(t)
    # the icon glyph, top right, at the headline's cap height
    t, w = text(font(SANS, wght=700, opsz=36), "", 0, 0, 72, g["ink"])
    body.append(t.replace("<path ", f'<path transform="translate({W - M - w} {M + 52})" ', 1))
    return card(W, H, g, body)


def mono_card(g):
    W, H, M = 1600, 760, 96
    mono, bold, label = font(MONO, wght=400), font(MONO, wght=700), font(MONO, wght=500)
    body = []
    t, _ = text(label, "LLAMA MONO", M, M + 20, 24, g["muted"], tracking=0.08)
    body.append(t)
    t, _ = text(bold, "llama.cpp", M, 248, 112, g["ink"])
    body.append(t)
    t, _ = text(font(SANS, wght=400, opsz=24), "Every character in one cell, coding ligatures included.", M, 324, 34,
                g["muted"])
    body.append(t)
    body.append(f'<rect x="{M}" y="380" width="{W - 2 * M}" height="1" fill="{g["line"]}"/>')
    # a command, its prompt muted and its flag in cinder
    size, y = 40, 470
    x = M
    for part, fill in (("$ ", g["muted"]), ("llama-server ", g["ink"]), ("-hf ", CINDER),
                       ("ggml-org/gemma-3-4b-it-GGUF", g["ink"])):
        t, w = text(mono, part, x, y, size, fill)
        body.append(t)
        x += w
    fits(x - M, W - 2 * M, "command")
    for i, line in enumerate(("const ok = (a, b) => a !== b && a >= 0;", "0O 1lI| {} [] () -> :: != www")):
        t, w = text(mono, line, M, 560 + i * 64, size, g["ink"])
        fits(w, W - 2 * M, line)
        body.append(t)
    return card(W, H, g, body)


def palette_card(g):
    W, H, M = 1600, 640, 96
    label, name_font = font(MONO, wght=400), font(SANS, wght=600, opsz=16)
    body = []
    t, _ = text(font(MONO, wght=500), "COLOURS", M, M + 20, 24, g["muted"], tracking=0.08)
    body.append(t)
    gap = 16
    n = len(COLOURS)
    tile = (W - 2 * M - gap * (n - 1)) / n
    top = 176
    for i, (name, _, hex_) in enumerate(COLOURS):
        x = M + i * (tile + gap)
        body.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{top}" width="{tile:.1f}" height="{tile * 1.4:.1f}" rx="16" '
                    f'fill="{hex_}" stroke="{g["line"]}"/>')
        t, w = text(name_font, name, x, top + tile * 1.4 + 40, 22, g["ink"])
        fits(w, tile + gap, name)
        body.append(t)
        t, _ = text(label, hex_.lower(), x, top + tile * 1.4 + 72, 20, g["muted"])
        body.append(t)
    # the two skies as grounds, after llama.app's hero
    y = top + tile * 1.4 + 112
    half = (W - 2 * M - gap) / 2
    def stops(parts):
        return "".join(f'<stop offset="{o:g}" stop-color="{c}"/>' for o, c in parts)

    def glow(id_, hex_, alpha, cx, cy, r):
        return (f'<radialGradient id="{id_}" cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="{r}">'
                f'<stop offset="0" stop-color="{hex_}" stop-opacity="{alpha:g}"/>'
                f'<stop offset="1" stop-color="{hex_}" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>')

    # the glows sit where css/colors.css puts them: the day's at the top left, the night's below the horizon
    day_glow, day_alpha, day_stops = sky("gradient-day-sky")
    night_glow, night_alpha, night_stops = sky("gradient-night-sky")
    body.append(
        '<defs>'
        f'<linearGradient id="day" x1="0.3" y1="0" x2="0.7" y2="1">{stops(day_stops)}</linearGradient>'
        f'{glow("day-glow", day_glow, day_alpha, 0.15, 0.1, 0.6)}'
        f'<linearGradient id="night" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">{stops(night_stops)}</linearGradient>'
        f'{glow("night-glow", night_glow, night_alpha, 0.5, 1.15, 0.7)}'
        '</defs>')
    for i, (name, ink) in enumerate((("day", INK), ("night", LIGHT))):
        x = M + i * (half + gap)
        for fill in (name, f"{name}-glow"):
            body.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{half:.1f}" height="64" rx="16" fill="url(#{fill})"/>')
        t, _ = text(label, f"--gradient-{name}-sky", x + 24, y + 40, 20, ink)
        body.append(t)
    return card(W, H, g, body)


def swatch(hex_):
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 40 40">'
            f'<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="39" height="39" rx="8" fill="{hex_}" stroke="rgb(128 128 128 / 0.4)"/>'
            f'</svg>\n')


def write(name, svg):
    path = os.path.join(HERE, name)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    open(path, "w").write(svg)
    print(os.path.relpath(path, os.path.join(HERE, "..")))


for tone, g in GROUNDS.items():
    write(f"llama-sans-{tone}.svg", sans_card(g))
    write(f"llama-mono-{tone}.svg", mono_card(g))
    write(f"colours-{tone}.svg", palette_card(g))
for _, token, hex_ in COLOURS:
    write(f"swatches/{token}.svg", swatch(hex_))
